item.title: CUTTO 0.6.0 for Windows
item.description:
Download `DOWNLOAD_CUTTO-0.6.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` to install CUTTO or update an existing owned installation.
- Split long timelines into verified working parts, then combine edited parts into a checked master. - Coordinate agents across timelines and inspect several timeline ranges in one call. - Prepare multichannel recordings as separate WAV sources. - View gift transcription status and estimated remaining hours in Account settings. - Improve source references, camera assignments and edit verification. - Use one complete setup file for first installation, manual updates and in-app updates.
Save your project and close DaVinci Resolve, CUTTO and MCP before running setup. Reopen Resolve afterward to load the updated Bridge. The app has no paid Authenticode certificate; Windows may show an unsigned-app warning.
